column1: iba_alexander|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_americano|Add ice, Campari and sweet vermouth to the glass. // Add a splash of soda and stir gently.
iba_angel_face|Shake all three spirits with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_aviation|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_bees_knees|Mix the honey syrup with both juices first. // Add gin and ice, shake, then strain into the glass.
iba_bellini|Gently mix peach puree and sparkling wine with ice in a mixing glass. // Strain into a chilled flute.
iba_between_the_sheets|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_black_russian|Add vodka and coffee liqueur to an ice-filled rocks glass. // Stir gently.
iba_bloody_mary|Gently mix the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass. // Transfer to the serving glass; a highball may be used when serving over ice.
iba_boulevardier|Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_bramble|Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice. // Strain over crushed ice, then drizzle blackberry liqueur around the surface.
iba_caipirinha|Cut the lime into wedges and gently muddle with sugar in the glass. // Add cracked ice and cachaca; mix gently.
iba_cardinale|Stir the ingredients with ice until cold. // Strain into a cocktail glass.
iba_clover_club|Shake the ingredients thoroughly with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_corpse_reviver_2|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_cosmopolitan|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a large cocktail glass.
iba_cuba_libre|Fill a highball with ice; add rum and lime juice. // Add cola and mix gently.
iba_daiquiri|Dissolve the fine sugar fully in the liquids. // Add ice, shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_dark_n_stormy|Fill a highball with ice and add ginger beer first. // Slowly float the rum on top.
iba_dry_martini|Stir gin and dry vermouth with ice. // Strain into a chilled martini glass.
iba_espresso_martini|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_french_75|Shake the first three ingredients with ice and strain into a flute. // Add Champagne and mix gently; never shake the Champagne.
iba_french_connection|Add ice and both spirits to a rocks glass. // Stir gently.
iba_french_martini|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_garibaldi|Add Campari and orange juice to an ice-filled highball. // Mix gently.
iba_gin_basil_smash|Shake the ingredients vigorously with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_gin_fizz|Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice. // Strain into a thin-walled glass and finish with a little soda.
iba_grasshopper|Shake the ingredients briefly with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_hanky_panky|Stir all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_horses_neck|Add cognac and ginger ale to an ice-filled glass; mix gently. // Add aromatic bitters if desired.
iba_irish_coffee|Warm the coffee glass. Mix hot coffee, whiskey and sugar until dissolved. // Slowly pour cold cream over the back of a spoon so it floats on top.
iba_john_collins|Add all liquids to an ice-filled highball. // Mix gently to preserve the soda's carbonation.
iba_jungle_bird|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into an ice-filled rocks glass.
iba_kir|Pour blackcurrant liqueur into the glass first. // Add the dry white wine.
iba_last_word|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_lemon_drop_martini|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_long_island_iced_tea|Add spirits, lemon juice and syrup to an ice-filled highball. // Finish with cola and mix gently.
iba_mai_tai|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Pour into a double rocks glass; a highball is an alternative.
iba_manhattan|Stir the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_margarita|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_martinez|Stir the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_mimosa|Pour orange juice into a flute first. // Add sparkling wine and mix gently.
iba_mojito|Gently mix mint, lime juice and sugar; add a little soda. // Add ice and rum, top with the remaining soda and mix gently.
iba_moscow_mule|Add the ingredients and ice to a mule mug or rocks glass. // Mix gently.
iba_naked_and_famous|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_negroni|Chill a rocks glass, add ice and the three spirits. // Stir gently.
iba_new_york_sour|Shake everything except the red wine with ice. // Strain over ice in a rocks glass, then slowly float the wine over a spoon.
iba_old_cuban|Shake everything except the sparkling wine with ice. // Strain into a cocktail glass and add the dry sparkling wine.
iba_old_fashioned|Moisten the sugar cube with bitters and a little water; muddle until dissolved. // Add ice and whiskey and mix gently.
iba_paloma|Mix tequila, lime juice and salt in a highball, then add ice. // Add grapefruit soda and mix gently.
iba_paper_plane|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_penicillin|Muddle fresh ginger in the shaker; add everything except Islay whisky and shake with ice. // Fine-strain over ice in a rocks glass, then float the Islay whisky.
iba_pina_colada|Blend the ingredients with ice. // Pour into a large glass.
iba_pisco_sour|Shake everything except the garnish bitters with ice. // Strain into a chilled glass and finish with bitters.
iba_rusty_nail|Add ice and both spirits to a rocks glass. // Stir gently.
iba_sazerac|Rinse and chill a rocks glass with absinthe. // Stir the remaining ingredients separately with ice. Discard ice and excess absinthe from the serving glass, then strain in the drink.
iba_sidecar|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_singapore_sling|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a hurricane glass.
iba_spritz|Add ice, Prosecco and Aperol to a wine glass. // Add a little soda and mix gently.
iba_whiskey_sour|Shake the ingredients with ice; shake thoroughly when using egg white. // Strain into the serving glass; a rocks glass with fresh ice is an option.
note_appletini|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled glass.
note_el_diablo|Shake the first three ingredients with ice and strain into an ice-filled highball. // Add ginger beer and mix gently.
note_chimayo|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into the serving glass.
note_godfather|Stir both spirits with ice. // Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
note_not_so_dark_but_stormy|Fill a highball with ice; add rum and lime juice. // Add ginger beer and mix gently.
note_espresso_cream|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
note_bramble_cassis|Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice. // Strain over crushed ice, then drizzle blackcurrant liqueur on top.
note_margarita_notebook|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled glass; an optional half salt rim may be used.
note_daiquiri_notebook|Shake the ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled glass.
note_old_fashioned_simple|Stir the ingredients with ice until cold. // Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.

iba_brandy_crusta|Moisten the rim with orange or lemon and coat with fine sugar; place the peel curl inside. // Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass and strain into the prepared narrow cocktail glass.
iba_canchanchara|Mix honey, water and lime juice, coating the base and inside of the glass. // Add crushed ice and cane spirit; stir thoroughly from the bottom up.
iba_casino|Shake all ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled rocks glass with ice.
iba_champagne_cocktail|Place the sugar cube in a large Champagne glass, add bitters and cognac; a few drops of Grand Marnier are optional. // Slowly pour in cold Champagne.
iba_chartreuse_swizzle|Pour the ingredients into a tall glass and add pebble ice. // Swizzle rapidly with a swizzle stick or bar spoon, then fill with more pebble ice.
iba_dons_special_daiquiri|Briefly flash-blend the ingredients with crushed ice in a milkshake mixer. // Pour into a footed copo glass and add more crushed ice.
iba_fernandito|Add ice and Fernet Branca to a double rocks glass. // Top with cola and stir gently.
iba_grand_margarita|Prepare a sea-salt rim on a rocks glass and add ice. // Shake the ingredients vigorously with ice for about 10 seconds and strain into the glass.
iba_hemingway_special|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_iba_tiki|Gently muddle a thin slice of ginger in the shaker, then add the other ingredients. // Shake vigorously with ice and strain into a chilled tiki mug over pebble ice.
iba_illegal|Shake the mixing ingredients vigorously with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass, or serve in a clay mug over ice.
iba_mary_pickford|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_mint_julep|Gently muddle mint, sugar and water in a stainless steel julep cup. // Fill with crushed ice, add bourbon and stir until the outside frosts.
iba_missionarys_downfall|Blend all ingredients with half a cup of crushed ice. // Serve in a large cocktail glass.
iba_monkey_gland|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_paradise|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_pisco_punch|Gently muddle cloves with simple syrup. Add everything except white wine and shake thoroughly. // Double-strain into a large goblet; finish with white wine and stir gently.
iba_planters_punch|Pour the ingredients into a small tumbler or traditional clay cup. // Dilute to taste with water, ice or fresh fruit juice; confirm the amount separately.
iba_porn_star_martini|Reserve Champagne for a separate glass. Shake the other ingredients with ice. // Double-strain into a large chilled cocktail glass and serve 50 ml Champagne alongside.
iba_porto_flip|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_rabo_de_galo|Add the ingredients and ice to a rocks glass. // Stir briefly to combine.

iba_ramos_fizz|Shake everything except soda with ice for about 2 minutes and double-strain into an intermediate vessel. // Return the strained liquid to the shaker and shake hard without ice for about 1 minute. // Strain into a tall glass and top with soda.
iba_remember_the_maine|Swirl absinthe around a coupe, then discard it. // Add the other ingredients to a mixing glass about three-quarters full of ice. Stir cold and strain into the rinsed coupe.
iba_russian_spring_punch|Shake everything except sparkling wine with ice and strain into a chilled tall glass over ice. // Top with sparkling wine.
iba_sea_breeze|Build all ingredients directly in an ice-filled tall glass.
iba_sex_on_the_beach|Mix all ingredients directly in an ice-filled tall glass.
iba_sherry_cobbler|Briefly shake both sherries, sugar and orange/lemon slices with ice. // Strain into a julep cup filled with crushed ice.
iba_south_side|Shake the ingredients with ice, more vigorously when using egg white. // Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_spicy_fifty|Shake all ingredients thoroughly with ice. // Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_stinger|Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass until cold. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_suffering_bastard|Shake everything except ginger beer with ice. // Pour the full contents, including ice, into a Collins glass or traditional mug, then top with ginger beer.
iba_tequila_sunrise|Pour tequila and orange juice into an ice-filled tall glass. // Add grenadine last to form a gradient; do not stir.
iba_three_dots_and_a_dash|Briefly flash-blend the ingredients with the source's 12 ounces of crushed ice. // Pour into a footed copo glass and add more crushed ice.
iba_tipperary|Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass until cold. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_tommys_margarita|Shake the ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled rocks glass over ice.
iba_trinidad_sour|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_tuxedo|Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass until cold. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_ve_n_to|Shake the ingredients vigorously with ice. // Strain into a chilled small tumbler over ice.
iba_vesper|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_vieux_carre|Stir the ingredients with ice in a mixing glass until cold. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_white_lady|Shake the listed mixing ingredients with ice. // Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba_zombie|Place all ingredients and 170 g crushed ice in an electric blender. // Pulse for a few seconds and pour into a tall tumbler.
